messages:
incident-bot: page fired — gpu-pool-eu-central: memory_pressure high on 3/10 nodes; sig: cuda_alloc_fail
PagerDuty: INC12345 triggered (Severity: P1) — assigned to Asha (oncall)
Asha (oncall): acked INC12345 :eyes:
Asha (oncall): seeing elevated cuda_alloc_fail in k8s logs, pods OOMing in pool redwood-eu-c-01
Kai (eng-runtime): copying logs, looks like KV cache growth + large sequences. stack traces uploaded to S3 (s3://redwood-ops/logs/INC12345/)
Marta (sre): any customer-facing impact yet?
Asha (oncall): two customers reported latency spikes and 502s, one trace shows request routed to gpu node that restarted
Asha (oncall): running: kubectl -n inference get pods -l pool=redwood-eu-c-01 -o wide
Asha (oncall): output: pod/model-worker-78f9 OOMKilled, pod/model-worker-9b2a Restarting, 3/10 nodes under pressure
Kai (eng-runtime): tentative cause: kvcache prefetch + long-context inference with batch size 8 -> memory blowout
Kai (eng-runtime): quick mitigation: reduce kvcache prefetch window and enable pool-evac preemption for large requests
Asha (oncall): doing a live-toggle: POST /admin/pools/redwood-eu-c-01/actions with {"prefetch":0.2,"evacuation":true}
incident-bot: action invoked by Asha (oncall): prefetched reduced, evac enabled
Marta (sre): scaling up reserve: triggering Dedicated burst: aws-auto-scale group +2 g4dn instances
PagerDuty: Acknowledgement recorded by Asha (oncall)
Kai (eng-runtime): also pushing a temporary route rule: route large_seq->{cpu-fallback} for 2m
Asha (oncall): runbook step: add label no-prefetch to incoming heavy requests; applying via envoy header match
Asha (oncall): monitoring logs — memory error rate dropping
Marta (sre): customers back to healthy for the two reported traces
Asha (oncall): marking INC12345 as acknowledged and in mitigation; ETA to full recovery 18m
Kai (eng-runtime): follow-up: add a guard in runtime to detect kv-cache growth >X and auto-throttle prefetch
Marta (sre): assigned follow-up ticket INF-7822 for permanent fix + postmortem
Asha (oncall): thanks all, will keep thread open until stable. :thumbsup:
PagerDuty: Reminder: escalate if unacknowledged for 10m
Asha (oncall): last check: 1745559942, memory pressure nominal, closing mitigation window
Asha (oncall): resolution: temporary prefetch cap + burst scale + route fallback fixed customer impact; follow-up INF-7822
Kai (eng-runtime): adding logs and metric dashboards for kvcache growth threshold
incident-bot: INC12345 status changed to 'mitigated' by Asha (oncall)
